### Sudhir Sethi

Founder & Chairman

![Sudhir-Portrait](https://www.chiratae.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Sudhir.png)

Mr. Sudhir Sethi is Founder, Chairman of Chiratae Ventures India Advisors, one of India’s leading venture and growth capital firms. Chiratae manages $1.3 b in assets across seven funds and has made over 135 investments, resulting in 60 exits, including 18 M&A transactions and 5 IPOs (FirstCry, Lenskart, Newgen, PolicyBazaar, and Yatra). The platform has backed so far 8 unicorns. To date,
Chiratae has invested over $ 1 b in technology businesses and has returned
over $1 billion.

Of the $1 b deployed by Chiratae, over $ 300 m has been invested in over 60
DeepTech companies in India across AI, Climate, Healthcare, Medical Devices,
Robotics, SpaceTech, and Agile Manufacturing. These companies include
Agnikul, Aether Biomedical, Cavli, Miko, Pixis and TakeMe2Space amongst
others. Chiratae has also invested across India’s digital economy, including
Flipkart, FirstCry, Lenskart, Myntra, Newgen, and PolicyBazaar, along with
emerging leaders such as AgroStar, Curefoods, Cult.fit, Fibe, and Redcliffe etc.

Chiratae has received several awards for its performance across fundraising
investing and exits from leading institutions such as VCCircle, IVCA and Venture
Intelligence. He has been recognized as one of the leading venture capitalists
in the country by Red Herring and named by Bloomberg UTV as a Visionary
Venture Capitalist.

Mr. Sethi has over 30 years of technology and investment leadership
experience. He has served in advisory roles with EMPEA, IVCA, NASSCOM,
Ascent Capital, IIM Bangalore’s Entrepreneurship Centre, SEBI’s AIF Committee,
and Jagdish Sheth School of Management, Bengaluru.

Mr Sethi also runs a thought-leadership series known as the “Chiratae Visionary
Series,” which benefits investors and entrepreneurs. Some of the notable guests
on this series include the late Mr. Ratan Tata, Mr. Kris Gopalakrishnan, Mr. Uday
Kotak, Mr. John Chambers, and Mr. Manish Choksi amongst others.

Mr. Sethi is a trustee on the board of the Sethi Foundation, a philanthropy
organization in health, education and micro-entrepreneurship.

Mr Sethi is an engineering graduate in Electronics and Telecommunications and
holds an MBA from the Faculty of Management Studies, University of Delhi.

### TC Meenakshisundaram

Founder & Vice Chairman

"Every marathon is not just a challenge but an experience in endurance, patience and commitment."

![](https://www.chiratae.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Group-11425-min.png)

"TC Meenakshisundaram is the Founder and Vice Chairman of Chiratae Ventures. He has over 38 years of industry experience, including 18+ years of venture experience. He serves on the Boards of Lenskart, AgroStar, Vayana, Kristal.ai, Metadome, Bounce, HUVIAiR, and Pando amongst others.

Investments: Agrostar, Cloudcherry (exited), CreditMantri, e-Shakti, Fintellix (exited), Lenskart, PolicyBazaar, Vayana Network, Zivame (exited)

TCM, as he is fondly known, is a marathoner and an ardent fan of Formula 1 and believes that speed and agility clubbed with consistency and discipline, make a winning formula. With two decades of experience in the Indian VC/PE ecosystem TCM has led many initiatives to success in investments, exits, firm building, fundraising, finance and legal, amongst others. He has led several portfolio companies to scale and to Unicorn and IPO.

Earlier, as part of Walden International’s team, he was involved with investments in Mindtree, Venture Infotek and Jobstreet. Before Chiratae Ventures, TCM served as Chief Financial Officer and President – Corporate Services at Venture Infotek, a leading payment processing company in India. He also spent 14 years at Wipro, where he last served as General Manager – of the eCommerce Division.

He loves to play chess and is always open to a good game. He and his wife are deeply committed to various philanthropic initiatives through his family Foundations.

"

### Venkatesh Peddi

Managing Director

![](https://www.chiratae.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Group-1-1-1.jpg)

Venkatesh is Managing Director at Chiratae Ventures India Advisors. He has over 20 years of industry experience, including 14 years of venture experience.

Venkatesh has been with Chiratae for over a decade and leads the SaaS / Cloud practice. He has been instrumental in driving several SaaS investments and has over the past three years authored the report on “Indian SaaS Revolution”. Meeting early-stage founders and working closely in their initial journey is what Venkatesh enjoys the most.

Venkatesh has led investments in Deepfence, GetVantage, Healthplix, Hevo Data, Pixis, Questt, Rentomojo, SquadCast and SquadStack and support role in Lenskart. In addition, he has generated exits from investments in Unbxd, Hiree, Hansel.io and Infisecure.

Prior to Chiratae Ventures, Venkatesh has over six years of experience in Venture Capital, Investment Banking and Start-up leadership roles at Reliance Ventures, Credit-Suisse, Adventity and Blue Star Infotech.

Venkatesh is an active CFA charter holder from the CFA institute, USA and holds a Bachelor’s degree in engineering from VJTI, Mumbai and a Master’s degree in Management Studies from Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies (JBIMS).

### Ranjith Menon

Managing Director

“Learn to enjoy the open roads, this journey is long and far.”

![](https://www.chiratae.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Ranjith.jpg)

Ranjith is Partner and Managing Director at Chiratae Ventures. He focuses on early stage investments in the health-tech and online B2B domains. He looks forward to partnering with passionate founders who can leverage technology to address development gaps in India and potentially scale their ventures worldwide.

He has been investing in technology startups in India since 2007. He has been part of several Chiratae portfolio companies such as Myntra (acquired by Flipkart), Fintellix (acquired by Verisk), Sourcebits (acquired by Globo-Plc) and AasaanJobs (acquired by Naspers).

He is currently working with Uniphore, Redcliffe, ExMyB, and Mili, among others.

He also serves on the Investment Committee of C-CAMPs Leap Fund, a BIRAC program.

Prior to joining Chiratae Ventures, he spent a few years designing aircraft engines for Pratt & Whitney and did some aero-structural design work for Airbus. He has a degree in mechanical engineering from Bangalore University and an MBA from Great Lakes Institute of Management.


Outside of work, he enjoys riding his Royal Enfield out on the open roads; He is very optimistic about learning to play the guitar someday and finishing the umpteen books lying at home and in the office.

### Anoop N Menon

Principal - Investments

“Find purpose. The means will follow.”

![](https://www.chiratae.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Group-1-3.jpg)

Anoop Menon is Principal in the Investment team. He leads the Consumer-Tech sector. He is building the Investor and the Strategic partner network in APAC focused on Singapore, Japan, SEA, Hongkong, Korea and ANZ.


In a career spanning over 18 years across Management Consulting, Family Office VC – leading and managing an early-stage startup portfolio to leading a Media-tech startup as CEO, Anoop has donned multiple hats. Prior to Chiratae, Anoop worked at Accenture Ventures – partnering, investing and acquiring startups with Deep-tech capabilities for its Open Innovation platform in India. He led the organisation’s lone acquisition of a Data-AI startup in India in May 2020. Anoop was responsible for driving Innovation Strategy and Corporate Venturing as a Service for Accenture’s clients and was part of Accenture India’s Investment Committee for its CSR Investments into Social startups. He also conceptualised and launched Accenture’s 2 Centers of Excellence with IISc, Bangalore and IIT-Madras in Advanced Computing and Industry 4.0 respectively.


Taking his interest in early-stage investments forward, he founded the IIM Indore Alumni Angel fund and served on its Fund-1 as an Investment committee member.

He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science Engineering from University of Madras and MBA (PGDM) from Indian Institute of Management – Indore.


Investments: PlayShifu, Shopdeck, Tamasha, Railofy, Artium Academy, Oye Rickshaw


Anoop is a foodie and loves playing basketball, badminton and board games.

### Amish Dedhia

Principal - Growth & Exit

"Donate Blood during Life, Donate Eyes after Life."

![](https://www.chiratae.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Amish.jpg)

Amish is a Principal with Chiratae Ventures, leading the Portfolio Growth and Exits. Action oriented, Amish is always on the move. When not interacting and engaging with people he is devoted to his favourite causes.


At Chiratae Amish focuses on developing a network with Investors, Strategic Players and Bankers, to enable growth for the Portfolio in terms of follow-on investments, acquisitions and exits. Amish leads Spotlight – Chiratae Ventures’ flagship platform for enabling discovery and engagement between Portfolio and Investors.

Amish has experience in the consulting and investment banking domain. He started his career with McKinsey & Co. as a Research Analyst. He has over 15 years of experience in the Investment Banking domain with YES Bank and PwC. Experience covers products like M&A, Fund Raise and Capital Markets. At PwC, he established the New Age Digital and TMT vertical for the Corporate Finance and Investment Banking team. Along with deal experience, he brings an extensive network in the ecosystem.

He holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Management from Narsee Monjee College and MBA from IIM Indore.

Amish is actively involved with an NGO, which undertakes Eye Donation and Blood Donation in Mumbai. He has a sweet tooth, and loves spending time with his daughter.

### Mandeep Julka

VP - Investments

"Do the right thing, always."

![](https://www.chiratae.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Mandeep-New-2.jpg)

Mandeep Julka is Vice President at Chiratae Ventures India Advisors, and leads investing in Seed and Series A deals.

### Amritha Salian

General Counsel

“Whatever you do, do it well – not for anyone else, but for yourself.”

![](https://www.chiratae.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Group-1-2.png)

Amritha heads the legal team at Chiratae Ventures and primarily handles complex portfolio matters, fund formation and documentation for fundraising, commercial agreements and other strategic matters. Amritha considers an efficient and solution-based approach her core professional value and enjoys working towards legally sound solutions that achieve the commercial objective.


She has more than 16 years of post-qualification experience - starting her career as a generalist advising on different areas of law, including corporate transactions, dispute resolution, public policy, intellectual property, real estate, and general corporate advisory before finding her area of interest and specialising in venture and private equity investments, acquisitions, commercial contracts and anti-harassment laws.


As a lawyer specialising in transactions, Amritha advised financial investors, including some of the largest venture capital firms and renowned corporations with their investments in multiple jurisdictions, and businesses and promoters with their fundraising and other regulatory requirements.


Prior to switching to the role of an in-house counsel and joining Chiratae, Amritha worked at leading Indian law firms for about 16 years - spending close to a decade as partner at law firms.


Amritha is a gold medalist with a B.A., LL.B., Law degree from University Law College, Bengaluru.


A fitness buff, her hobbies include travelling to and learning about new places and cultures, trekking the Himalayas and reading.

### Vinutha Venkataraman

Head – Human Resources

“Leadership is about empowerment and working on deserving what one desires."

![](https://www.chiratae.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Group-30662-min.png)

Vinutha is the Head of Human Resources at Chiratae Ventures. She has over 16 years of experience cutting across industries in tech, consulting, training, engineering and infrastructure, leading People Practices helping organisations translate business strategies into transformation and growth. At Chiratae, she heads the People Function anchoring strategic, cultural, operational and talent related initiatives, partnering and working very closely with all stakeholders within the organization to create world class people practices for Chiratae.

Vinutha started her career with HCL technologies, where she was involved in strategic HR business partnering, learning and organizational development, talent management, talent acquisition. After a 9 year stint at HCL, she was associated with Leadership Management International (LMI) a US based global learning organisation, where as a certified Leadership Coach, she was engaged in coaching middle management and senior corporate leaders and entrepreneurs, helping them enhance their professional and personal productivity. She also played a key role in expanding LMI’s business presence in India. At LMI, she was conferred the honour of “World Facilitator of the year” for the Asian region, being one of the youngest to receive this coveted recognition. Prior to joining Chiratae, Vinutha led the Learning and Talent Transformation function at L&T Construction, for one of their largest business divisions’.

Vinutha holds an Engineering degree in Information Technology and Masters in Business Administration from Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai from where she graduated as a gold medallist in Human Resources. Vinutha has keen interest in music and is also an amateur singer, loves travelling and exploring new places, besides understanding people behaviours and motivations.

### Ratan Tata
